_rule.contraction: surface contains an apostrophe (straight ' or curly ’, e.g. don’t, i’m) -- contraction/possessive surface forms, not standalone concepts
_rule.morpheme_marker: surface begins with '+' OR ends with '+' (e.g. '+ed', 'to+') -- grammatical inflection markers, not concepts
_rule.pos_label: surface is exactly one of: adjectives, determiners, nouns, possessive -- POS category labels used as literal entries, not concepts
_rule.slash_form: surface contains a '/' and does not match the rules above (e.g. do/does) -- a combined-form entry, not a single concept
